critical_code_review_comments: usePair only syncs voxcpm_url/key into form state on a non-ready -> ready transition. If a re-run reports ready with a NEW url while the page last saw 'ready' (polling is 30s when ready, so a fast re-pair could be missed), form state keeps the old url and pressing Save would overwrite the new server url. Consider syncing whenever data.url !== s.voxcpm_url while stage is ready.
POST /api/voice/voxcpm-pair/{token} rate limit is 120/hour per IP; fine for one Colab (alive every 5 min), but multiple tenants behind one NAT/Colab egress IP could share the bucket — low risk.
Optional text-left on CollapsibleTrigger for wrapped label.
